deviations.why: No real testimonial data available in the intake; SECTION_POLICY.testimonial prohibits fabricated testimonials.
No booking flow exists in the data contract; forms are out of scope for server components.

deviations.what: Removed "12 Years of Experiences" counter circle
deviations.why: No verifiable experience metric provided; avoiding invented statistics per truth contract.

deviations.what: Replaced animated hero heading words with static HERO_WORD
deviations.why: Server component has no JavaScript for animation; preserving layout with simplified content.

deviations.what: Repurposed timeline section to display services in sequence
deviations.why: Original timeline had step-by-step milestones (vaccine, consulting, etc.) that are not service data; adapted to show d.services with structural labels "Βήμα X" to preserve alternating timeline layout.

deviations.what: Removed TemplateMo credit link from footer
deviations.why: LICENSE-MAP.md indicates credit should be removed explicitly.

notes: Faithful port of Medic Care (Templatemo) preserving overall layout, color palette, typography, and alternating timeline structure. Adaptations made only where data contract lacks corresponding fields. All images bound to d.gallery items.
